features_verified: 1. Quick Decisions summary card appears at page top with multi-vendor items sorted by spread desc
2. Each quick decision shows: item name, best vendor, save %, worst vendor, best price
3. Decision banner inside each expanded multi-vendor group: 'Buy from X — save Y% vs Z'
4. Decision banner shows exact $/LB comparison and per-pound savings
5. Best Deal badge (green) appears on cheapest vendor row in multi-vendor groups
6. High Price badge (red) appears on most expensive vendor row in multi-vendor groups
7. No Best Deal/High Price badges on single-vendor groups
8. Spread badge color: red for >=15%, amber for 8-15%, green for <8%
9. $/LB column: best row green, worst row red, middle rows default
10. Signal column header present in table
11. Decision banner NOT shown for single-vendor groups
